notes.title: PlayTest finish and game release
notes.notes:
Dear Players,
We are pleased to inform you that our PlayTest will close on February 15.
The start of sales is scheduled for February 18/19.
All who have made transactions in the game please write in private messages via this link https://steamcommunity.com/id/skullcapstudios/.
We  will give you a key to the game for free.
